title: The Diverse crowd in the square
subtitle: 语言文化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）
meta: 主题语境：语言文化（人与社会·历史社会与文化·语言与文化）　|　核心词汇：diverse　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 diverse 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1990 the keeper wrote of ① a diverse crowd in the square in the register, and everybody in the zoo said at once that it was ② more diverse than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the diverse ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most diverse crowd in the square anybody in the zoo had ever seen, or so the register for March 1984 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too diverse to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the diverse ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a diverse mixture of dialects, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as diverse as the mixture of dialects they had once had in the old zoo. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was diverse or not, and he said so.

By 1997 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something diverse, and nothing besides. The child from the next zoo called the whole plan ⑧ quite diverse; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the diverse ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2000, on the same day, she wrote of another diverse crowd in the square in the same register, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed ⑨ more diverse than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most diverse mixture of dialects in the whole zoo, she said in 2002, was the one she could never quite name; the diverse ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 多样（前置定语 a diverse crowd in the square：1990 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的那件多样的人群）
B. adj. 多样／形形色色（比较级 more diverse than：文中两处，一处比广场上的人群，一处比预想）
C. adj. 多样／形形色色（最高级 the most diverse：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 多样（表语 too diverse to do：母亲觉得它太多样，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 形形色色（前置定语 a diverse mixture of dialects：叔叔把整件事称作一桩形形色色的方言）
F. adj. 形形色色（同级比较 as diverse as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩混杂的方言相比）
G. adj. 形形色色（后置定语 something diverse：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 形形色色（受程度副词修饰 quite diverse：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a diverse crowd in the square
the most diverse crowd in the square anybody
The most diverse mixture of dialects in

answers.why: diverse 意为“多样”，1990 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的是“一件多样的人群”，此处作前置定语 a diverse crowd in the square。
diverse 意为“多样”，此处用比较级 more diverse than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
diverse 意为“多样”，饲养台账上 三月 那行字说它是兽舍里最多样的一件，故用最高级 the most diverse crowd in the square。
diverse 意为“多样”，母亲认为这件东西“太多样了，谁也用不上”，too diverse to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
diverse 意为“形形色色”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩形形色色的方言”，此处作前置定语 a diverse mixture of dialects。
diverse 意为“形形色色”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩混杂的方言一样形形色色”，同级比较用 as diverse as。
diverse 意为“形形色色”，饲养台账上那半行字要的是“形形色色的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something diverse。
diverse 意为“形形色色”，邻兽舍来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当形形色色”，quite 修饰原级 diverse。
diverse 意为“形形色色”，2000 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要形形色色”，故用比较级 more diverse than。
diverse 意为“形形色色”，母亲 2002 年说的是“整个兽舍里最形形色色的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most diverse mixture of dialects。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1990 年，饲养员在饲养台账里记下了一件多样的人群。（a diverse crowd in the square）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更多样。（more diverse than …）
母亲觉得它太多样，谁也用不上。（too diverse to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩形形色色的方言。（a diverse mixture of dialects）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩混杂的方言一样形形色色。（as diverse as …）
到了 1997 年，饲养台账上只剩半行字：要的是一件形形色色的东西。（something diverse）
answers: In 1990 the keeper wrote of a diverse crowd in the square in the register.
Everybody said it was more diverse than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too diverse to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a diverse mixture of dialects.
He said nobody would call it as diverse as the mixture of dialects they had once had.
By 1997 the register asked for nothing but something diverse.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 diverse 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1990 the keeper wrote of a diverse crowd in the square in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most diverse crowd in the square in the zoo, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too diverse to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a diverse mixture of dialects, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next zoo called the plan quite diverse, and everybody laughed.
The diverse ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
